nodes.title: §1 Purpose — Responsibilities of this crate
nodes.summary: Defines the siprs crate's purpose: providing safe async PJSUA access for SIP calling via tokio-native API, limited to audio only.

nodes.title: §7.2 RuntimeCommand & Command Serialization

nodes.title: §8 Public API Design

nodes.summary: TransportConfig enum (UDP/TCP/TLS), TlsConfig, IceConfig, StunServerConfig, TurnServerConfig definitions. Full ICE support with trickle ICE as optional optimization.

nodes.title: §14 Error Design — SipError & SipErrorKind
